title: nodejs/node 2021-02-23, Version 15.10.0 (Current), @BethGriggs
summary:
This is a security release.
Notable changes
Vulnerabilities fixed:
CVE-2021-22883: HTTP2 'unknownProtocol' cause Denial of Service by resource exhaustion
Affected Node.js versions are vulnerable to denial of service attacks when too many connection attempts with an 'unknownProtocol' are established.
